shortcutHint.message: By default Alt+Shift+S (Option+Shift+S on a Mac) saves the page you are on without opening the popup. If that tab saved something in the last 10 minutes, nothing is sent and the icon shows a grey ✓. Change the keys at chrome://extensions/shortcuts (Chrome leaves the shortcut unset when another extension already uses it: pick one there).
